items.html: Remember, and never forget this rule: that always, in all the Partzufim of Atzilut, all the Chasadim are drawn from the new name Mah that came to correct Atzilut, and all the Gevurot are from the name Ban of the sorting of the kings. This is the secret of the coupling to sweeten the Gevurot of the Nukva, the name Ban, which are now being sorted anew, in every single coupling, in the secret of Mayin Nukvin, as above — through the Chasadim drawn from them, the new Mah.
